subject: Coaching checkpoints and deliverable plan before formal PIP - Rohan Mehta
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tracy Hart <tracy.hart@acmehr.com>
Date: 2027-04-18T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Coaching checkpoints and deliverable plan before formal PIP - Rohan Mehta

Hi Laura and Jordan,

Following our 1:1 last week and the calibration with People Ops, I want to share a concise set of coaching checkpoints for Rohan that we can use to avoid escalating to a formal PIP if we see measurable improvement. I attached a one-page checklist and the ticket/activity export for context.

Summary of main concerns (short):
- Missed SLAs on priority Incident tickets (avg response time now ~48h; target 8h).
- Several reviews with incomplete follow-through on agreed action items.
- Priority communication gaps with cross-functional partners (commitment vs delivery).

Proposed short coaching plan (4 weeks):
1) Week 1: Clarify expectations and agree on 3 measurable deliverables. Schedule a 30-min alignment with KB/ops.
2) Week 2: Shadow sessions (pair on 2 priority tickets). Daily stand check-ins Mon/Wed/Fri (15 min).
3) Week 3: Ownership: lead triage for two incidents; deliver postmortem draft.
4) Week 4: Review outcomes against the 3 deliverables and determine next steps.

Escalation criteria to move to a formal PIP: missed 2+ agreed deliverables or no sustained improvement in SLA metrics.

Please confirm you can join a short sync tomorrow to finalize the checklist. Tracy, appreciate People Ops visibility — we won't copy Rohan into this thread until we've agreed on the coaching approach.

Thanks,

Marissa Cole
Engineering Manager, Platform
Redwood Inference

Attachments: coaching_checklist_q2.xlsx (spreadsheet), rohan_last_60_tickets.csv (csv export)

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tracy Hart <tracy.hart@acmehr.com>
Date: 2027-04-18T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Coaching checkpoints and deliverable plan before formal PIP - Rohan Mehta

Marissa — thanks for the clear outline. I reviewed the ticket export and agree the SLA delta is the core metric we can track. A couple of quick points:
- For Week 1, let's include a written commitments doc that Rohan signs off on (simple one-pager).
- For shadowing, Jordan can allocate two 90-min blocks next week.
- Can we set the daily stand-ins as 9:15am PST so he can align before triage?

Tracy — can you confirm any People Ops requirements for documentation to keep before a PIP starts? I want to ensure the coaching record is compliant.

I'll be available for the sync at 10:00am tomorrow.

—Laura
Laura Bennett
Director, Customer Reliability
Redwood Inference

From: Tracy Hart <tracy.hart@acmehr.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-04-18T12:35:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Coaching checkpoints and deliverable plan before formal PIP - Rohan Mehta

Hi team,

Thanks for the heads-up — this approach looks sound. People Ops expects the following to be documented pre-PIP:
- Clear, time-bound expectations and measurable criteria (you have that).
- Evidence of coaching activities (meeting notes, shadowing logs, paired sessions).
- A record of the employee's acknowledgement of the coaching plan (email or signed doc).

If you decide to proceed with the coaching track, please upload the one-pager and meeting notes to the People Ops portal (I included a link below). If it progresses to a PIP, we'll need the same artifact set plus an updated improvement plan template.

Best,
Tracy Hart
Sr. People Partner
Acme HR (consulting)

People Ops portal: https://peopleops.acmehr.com/cases/RED-783

Subject: Re: Coaching checkpoints and deliverable plan before formal PIP - Rohan Mehta

Quick update following the sync this morning and the first round of shadowing:
- Rohan accepted the three deliverables and provided suggested prioritization (see attached meeting notes).
- We did two paired-ticket sessions on Mon and Tue; improvement in response time on those tickets was visible (avg ~10h for the paired items).
- He committed to the 9:15am stand check-ins starting next Monday.

Next steps:
- Marissa: upload the signed one-pager and meeting notes to the People Ops portal (RED-783) by EOD tomorrow.
- Laura: book two additional shadowing blocks in Week 2 and add a calendar reminder for the week-4 review.
- Tracy: please confirm if this artifact set will be sufficient for pre-PIP documentation or if you want the paired-session logs in a particular template.

If the Week 3 ownership items do not meet the agreed definition, we'll reconvene and discuss moving to a formal PIP. For now, the coaching route is active.

Thanks,
Jordan Blake
Staff Engineer, Incident Response
Redwood Inference

Attachment referenced: meeting_notes_20270425.txt (see People Ops upload)
